Redefine_Guidelines: Product requirements must focus on customer-facing improvements and visible touchpoints.
Requirements must be insight-driven and measurable.
Do not reference 'Equal or better than Predecessor' in requirement thresholds or targets.
Functional and experience improvements require specific, measurable metrics.
Channel requests for feature, experience, or warranty improvements to the appropriate function owners (Marketing, GxD, TME) for holistic assessment.
Do not include best practices or general engineering/process guidelines.

In_Scope_Product_Specific: Performance/Feature requirements specific to the product.
Quality Improvement & Serviceability unique to the product.
Documentation and Process related to the product.
Test Setup/Fixture specific to the product.
Design For Manufacturing for the specific product.
Cost Reduction that applies to the product.

Threshold_Target_Guidelines.Guideline: Requirement thresholds and targets must be specific, measurable, and avoid vague statements such as 'equal or better than predecessor'.
Threshold_Target_Guidelines.Challenge: It is difficult for Quality and Marketing to write technical specs or values for subjective requirements.
Threshold_Target_Guidelines.Past_Practice: Use of 'equal or better than predecessor' as requirement.
Threshold_Target_Guidelines.Proposal: State what the customer expects instead of vague statements. Example:

Example_Case_1_Tire_Mark.Requirement_From_Customer_Perspective: No visible tire mark on photo media.
Example_Case_1_Tire_Mark.Threshold_Acceptable_to_Ship: Minor tire mark acceptable (metric to be defined with program).
